name: gta-6-ps5-install-size-210gb-report
note: تقرير: the PlayStation Game Size account (a known PS Store datamine profile) lists GTA VI on PS5 at 210 GB (first outlet Insider Gaming 27 Oct 17:17Z; Push Square, GameSpot, GamesRadar, Polygon after). Rockstar has not stated a size; no Xbox figure. Release 19 Nov 2026 (official). Footage: Rockstar's official launch trailer (IGN 4K file, x1.0), shots picked scene by scene from a 0.5 s sheet, mostly not used in the 26 Oct GTA Reel, clear of guns, the intimate scenes (41.7-46.3), slates and billboard text. Sound: the trailer's score from 13.6 s, the same stretch as the 26 Oct Reel (speechcheck 13.6 + 17 s: none; the song with lyrics starts near 29 s).
